remarks: The Deck House, a true masterpiece of modern design, seamlessly blending architectural brilliance with the beauty of its natural surroundings and an incredible offering of outdoor living. Oversized windows invite natural light in and and frame the views of the surrounding landscape. Rich wood finishes and natural stone surfaces create an organic aesthetic throughout. The main floor is designed with versatility in mind, offering bright, open-concept living and dining spaces perfect for gathering, along with a quieter wing with two bedrooms and a lounge. Upstairs, you'll find the luxurious primary suite with dressing room, sleek bath, corner fireplace and deck access, an additional en suite bedroom, a dedicated office, and a home gym. And then there's the outdoors-a true haven for both relaxation and recreation. Expansive decks on multiple layers, and a sparkling salt water pool set the stage for enjoying the company of family and friends, while the sport court adds extra fun. The professionally designed landscaping and lighting bring the spaces to another level. Located on a quiet cul-de-sac right in the center of town, this special home is close to town, schools, shopping and dining!
